# Ship Sh!t Show — YouTube Content Repo
# https://github.com/shipshitshow/youtube

> Weekly livestream on AI tools, indie dev, and shipping fast.
> Full episode scripts, transcripts, and show notes — structured for LLM consumption.

## Episodes

All episodes are in content/episodes/YYYY-MM-DD-slug/
Each folder contains:
- index.md      — YAML frontmatter (id, title, date, youtube_id, topics, chapters) + summary
- transcript.md — Full episode transcript
- notes.md      — Show notes and resources
- thumbnail.prompt.md — AI image prompt used for the thumbnail

## Browse

- content/episodes/  — All episodes
- content/series/    — Playlist groupings
- content/topics/    — Topic indexes
- content/templates/ — Episode templates (weekly-stream.md)

## Metadata Schema (index.md frontmatter)

id: sss-NNN
title: string
date: YYYY-MM-DD
type: stream | short | interview
duration: H:MM:SS
youtube_id: string
topics: string[]
guests: string[]
news: [{title, source, url, hot_take}]
demo: {project, repo, goal, continuation}
chapters: [{time, title}]
